To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the asymptotic relative efficiency of the LS estimator of the dependence parameter is always less than one, but that the efficiency of the LS estimator of the Weibull parameter can be greater than one, depending on the value of the dependence parameter.

the asymptotic relative efficiency of the LS estimator of the dependence parameter is a decreasing function of the proportion of the component-data and that the asymptotic variances of the LS estimator of the dependence parameter are decreasing functions of the proportion of system-data.
the LS estimators of the multivariate Weibulls distribution are biased and that their joint asymptotic distributions are non-normal.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the accelerated life testing of a system consisting of two components in series and with the estimation of the parameters of the multivariate Weibulldistribution of Hougaard.
accelerated life testing (ALT) of components and systems.

the following: (a) the estimation of the multivariate Weibbull distribution of Hougaard based on accelerated data of both components and systems, (b) the asymptotic relative efficiency of the LS estimator of the multivariate model parameters, (c) the effect of the dependence parameter of the multivariate distribution, and (d) the effect of proportion of the system data to the asymptotic efficiency.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in the presence of dependence, the accelerated life test of systems and components can be used for parameter estimation of the multivariate Weibulldistribution of Hougaard.
the multivariate Weibulls distribution of Hougaard provides a good tool to model lifetimes in accelerated life tests of components and series systems.
the multivariate Weibbull model of Hougaard is very useful in the accelerated life testing of both components and systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can use the information collected from both accelerated life test of systems and components to obtain a better estimator of the system lifetime.
the LS estimators of the parameters are efficient when the dependence parameter is large.
the LS estimators of the parameters are consistent, and the asymptotic relative efficiency of the LS estimator of the shape parameter is greater than that of the LS estimator for the scale parameter.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the accelerated life test of the system can improve the estimation of the component parameters, especially when the system is highly reliable.

, if we are able to collect system data, then the LS estimator for the multivariate Weibulls distribution of Bouguard based on accelerated life tests of system and components is more efficient than the one based only on the component-data.
accelerated life tests of components can significantly reduce the variance of the LS estimator of the system reliability.
